title: CoCAD model definition, version 1
description: The file <model>.yml next to <model>.scad. It holds the text about the model, the parts and the parameter sets. The .scad file holds only OpenSCAD code.

^x-.description: A key for other tools. CoCAD does not read it.

author.description: The person or the group that made the model.

license.description: The license of the model, for example an SPDX identifier.

url.description: The web page of the model.

part_parameter.description: The string parameter of the .scad file that selects a part. The value "all" shows all parts. Default: part.

multicolor.description: true: the parts are the colors of one object. CoCAD keeps them together as one print part and exports a multicolor 3MF. false: each part is a separate print part.

parts.description: The values of the part parameter other than "all", in order. For a multicolor model, the order sets the filament number.

anyOf.description: The value of the part parameter. CoCAD uses it as the name.

sets.description: Parameter sets. The key is the name of the set.

id.description: The value of the part parameter that shows only this part.

name.description: The name that CoCAD shows. Default: the id.

color.description: The color of the part in the 3D view, and the filament color of a multicolor model: #RRGGBB or a color name (white, black, red, green, blue, yellow, orange, purple, pink, brown, cyan, magenta, gold, silver, gray, grey).

values.description: Parameter name and value. Parameters that are not in the set keep the default of the model.
